title: Cholesterol follow-up: lifestyle plan
synopsis: Discussed the high LDL. Because the 10-year heart risk is low, agreed to try six months of lifestyle changes before considering a statin: Mediterranean-style eating, fewer refined carbs, 150 minutes a week of moderate cardio, and daily fish oil.

findings.text: Lifestyle plan instead of statin, re-check in 6 months

report:
## Assessment

Hyperlipidemia, LDL 142. ASCVD 10-year risk 3.1%. Family history negative for premature CAD.

## Plan

1. Therapeutic lifestyle changes: Mediterranean diet pattern, limit saturated fat < 7% of calories, add 25–30 g/day soluble fiber.
2. Exercise: 150 min/week moderate aerobic activity plus 2 resistance sessions.
3. Omega-3 1 g daily.
4. Repeat fasting lipid panel in 6 months. Consider moderate-intensity statin if LDL remains > 130.
